style_label: Artistically completed cream-and-brick hostel facade; not surveyed reconstruction
rationale: The mapped feature identifies an eight-storey hostel. An orderly 3.2 m facade rhythm with cream walls and brick accents provides a readable residential character at campus scale. The facade palette, window rhythm, openings, shading and parapets are artistic choices, not observations of this building. Keep the existing six-vertex footprint, its placement and its 24 m body height unchanged. The 24 m value is derived from eight source-reported storeys times an assumed 3 m, not a measured height.
